page_note: Page 58 = Chapter 18 on the Five Wars between Sons of Light and Sons of Darkness. Strongly substratic: systematic cosmic-conflict teaching using First Living Man, Living Spirit, Virgin/Living Fire, archons, five worlds, five elements, five counsels, the bitter tree. Two clear editorial intrusions: (1) seg 3 dialogue attribution "Then said the Illuminator", and (2) seg 17-18 Gospel citation "as the Saviour said: Behold, the axe is laid at the root of the [bitter] tree..." (Matt 3:10) — a 3rd-c. NT citation grafted onto the older bitter-tree/axe correspondence. The page is heavily damaged but the teaching architecture (First War of Living Man, Second War of Living Spirit) is intact and clearly substratic.
